application_review: PROGRESS. Previous audit rechecked and all baseline proof hashes preserved.
Each vertex uses the actual signed difference sum over its subset of Fin d. Its bound follows from Fin coordinate bounds and subset cardinality at most d.
The scale inequality uses the exact natural floor division q/(J*a), with J positive and q nonzero. No divisibility or discarded rounding error is assumed.
The complete product includes every subset vertex and applies the existing 4H/q bound with H=d*a*floor(q/(J*a)). The final constant is 4d/J, not exponential in the number of vertices.
The statement is uniform in fixed increment tuples; averaging these tuples and joining the Gowers bound remain subsequent work. Three new theorems are individually kernel audited.
